subject: MAP: POC onramp — API key lifecycle, org seed, IP allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@medvance.health>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & POC onramp — requirements and timeline

Hi Logan / team,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the product looked promising. We'd like to capture a short MAP so our security and infra teams can greenlight a two-week POC. High-level asks from our side:

- Org/tenant setup: Do we get a dedicated tenant or do we seed an org under your hosted offering?
- API keys: guidance on ephemeral vs long-lived keys, rotation cadence, and the process to generate a scoped key for our service account.
- IP allowlist: our firewall team will need a CSV of egress IPs (or an alternate plan if you require VPC peering).
- VPC peering: if you support peering for the POC, list the required VPC IDs, routing steps, and who runs the peering (us or Redwood).
- Timeline: we need everything ready to run smoke tests the week of Jul 12 — so we are aiming for network + keys by Jul 9.

I've attached a starter inventory (medvance-network-allowlist.csv) and a one-sheet of expected test scenarios. Our DevOps folks are on this thread — they can share CIDRs and VPC IDs once we confirm the approach.

Can you share a short MAP with owners and dates? Also please include any security docs you need from us (SOC2 attestations, IP policy, etc.).

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Product | MedVance Health
samira@medvance.health

Attachments: medvance-network-allowlist.csv (text/csv)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@medvance.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & POC onramp — requirements and timeline

Samira — great to kick this off. Per your asks, I drafted a compact MAP and proposed owners below. I attached the working MAP spreadsheet (rdw-map-medvance-v1.xlsx) and a short checklist for the network call.

High-level proposal (short):
- Org seed: Redwood creates a dedicated "medvance-eval" tenant in our hosted control plane. Internal owner: Ben Carter. External owner: Samira. Target date: 2027-07-07.
- API key model: For the POC we recommend scoped, short-lived API keys (ROTATE daily) backed by a service account. Neha will provision a service account and an initial scoped API token with 7-day TTL; we'll supply a rotation helper script. Owner: Neha Kapoor. Target date: 2027-07-06.
- IP allowlist: If you want to avoid peering for smoke tests, we'll provide a set of egress IPs and a /24 fallback. If you prefer VPC peering (recommended for sustained evals) we can do a managed peering with a 2-step handshake. Owner: Marissa for coordination, Neha for technical config. Request your CIDRs and VPC info by 2027-07-02.
- VPC peering: We support AWS VPC peering for POCs. Required from you: VPC ID, account ID, and preferred peering window. Redwood will create the peering request and exchange route tables; MedVance must accept the peering and add the routes. Owner: Neha (Redwood infra) + MedVance DevOps. Target window: 2027-07-08 to 2027-07-09.
- Acceptance: smoke tests performed by MedVance during week of 2027-07-12. If all green, we document a short summary and next steps for a pilot.

Quick asks from you now: share the two primary VPC IDs (production-eval and staging-eval) and the CIDR(s) you want whitelisted. Also confirm whether you want Redwood to propose egress IPs or go straight to peering.

Security docs: we can share a SOC 2 summary link (we do not need additional paperwork for the POC beyond basic org info and contact person). I linked the MAP draft in HubSpot and Drive.

I can jump on a 30-min network sync — propose Thu Jul 1 at 10:00am PT.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: rdw-map-medvance-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Related: https://hubspot.example/contacts/RDW-8243

From: DevOps Team <devops@medvance.health>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@medvance.health>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & POC onramp — requirements and timeline

On Wed, Jun 30, 2027 at 11:08 AM Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick asks from you now: share the two primary VPC IDs (production-eval and staging-eval) and the CIDR(s) you want whitelisted. Also confirm whether you want Redwood to propose egress IPs or go straight to peering.

Hi Logan / Samira —

We can provide the VPC details below. We're fine with a hybrid approach: allowlist your egress IPs for initial smoke tests, then establish peering for full feature validation.

- VPC IDs: vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f (prod-eval), vpc-0f1e2d3c4b5a (staging-eval)
- Account ID: 123456789012
- CIDRs used by our services that will call Redwood: 10.23.16.0/24, 10.23.17.0/24
- Preferred peering window: Jul 8, 13:00-15:00 PT (we can accept earlier if needed).

One security note: our infra team prefers not to allow a broad /24 outbound if we can avoid it. If you can provide a short list of expected egress IPs (or a named prefix) we can lock down the firewall rules to those IPs until the peering is active.

We have one small ask about key lifecycle: can you support token rotation via an API so we can automate refresh on our side? If so, please include the endpoints and an example curl.

Thanks,
DevOps Team
MedVance Health (devops@medvance.health)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@medvance.health>, DevOps Team <devops@medvance.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & POC onramp — requirements and timeline

Thanks — this is perfect. Quick confirmations and owner-level action items so we have a single source of truth: 

1) Org & tenant
- Redwood will provision "medvance-eval" tenant. Owner: Ben Carter. Action: Ben will send the tenant invite and the admin console link by 2027-07-07.

2) API keys & rotation
- Neha will provision an initial service-account token (7-day TTL) and an API endpoint to rotate keys: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/rotate (bearer auth required). We'll include a sample curl in the MAP sheet. Owner: Neha Kapoor. Target: token available 2027-07-06.

3) IP allowlist (short-term)
- Redwood will provide three egress IPs to whitelist for smoke tests: 3.122.45.21, 3.122.45.34, 3.122.45.56. These are documented in the shared MAP sheet. Owner: Marissa Cole to confirm distribution. Deadline: 2027-07-02.

4) VPC peering (handoff)
- Redwood infra (Neha) will open peering requests on Jul 8 at 13:00 PT. MedVance infra will accept and add routes within the agreed window. Owner: Neha Kapoor + MedVance DevOps.

5) Network sync and kickoff meeting
- Marissa will host a 30-min network sync to walk through the peering steps and validate firewall rules. Proposed: Jul 1, 10:00am PT. Action: Marissa to send calendar invite and dial-in.

6) Acceptance
- Smoke tests week of Jul 12. If all tests pass, we will capture a short summary and propose next steps (pilot scope and pricing).

Please reply with acceptance or any blockers. I'll mark the MAP as 'in progress' in HubSpot and attach the updated sheet.

Thanks everyone — looking forward.

—
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

CC: Ben Carter (sales lead) — will own account admin; Marissa Cole (CS) — will run the network call; Neha Kapoor (infra) — will manage keys & peering.
